Internet bidding is available through CCA with a 20% buyer's premium above the closing hammer price.

CCA has endeavored to accurately describe the items being auctioned. All property is being offered for auction in "as-is" condition. All sales are final, and no refunds will be given. It is the bidder's responsibility to determine the exact condition of each item. No statement in this catalog or by representatives of CCA shall be considered a warranty or assumption of liability. Written and oral descriptions given by CCA staff are provided as a courtesy and should not be considered a guarantee of age, composition, or authenticity. All clients are encouraged to inspect items prior to auction by scheduling an appointment or attending an open preview event at the CCA Gallery in Eastchester, New York. Clients may, at their own cost, arrange for a proxy (e.g. furniture restorer, automotive mechanic, art authenticator, etc.) to examine items on their behalf.

Invoices are sent to the registered email address of the winning bidder (Buyer) at the conclusion of the auction. Invoices must be paid no later than five business days following the auction. Failure to submit on-time payment may result in the forfeiture of items. Payment may be made by cash, wire transfer, or credit card. Automobile invoices must be paid via wire transfer. lines.text: CCA offers absentee and real-time internet bidding at coppercrownauctions.com. A bid placed prior to or during the auction constitutes a legally binding contract to purchase the item or lot at the cost of the bid, plus all additional charges, fees, and taxes as outlined in the terms and conditions that follow.
Internet bidding is available through CCA with a 20% buyer's premium above the closing hammer price.

CCA has endeavored to accurately describe the items being auctioned. All property is being offered for auction in "as-is" condition. All sales are final, and no refunds will be given. It is the bidder's responsibility to determine the exact condition of each item. No statement in this catalog or by representatives of CCA shall be considered a warranty or assumption of liability. Written and oral descriptions given by CCA staff are provided as a courtesy and should not be considered a guarantee of age, composition, or authenticity. All clients are encouraged to inspect items prior to auction by scheduling an appointment or attending an open preview event at the CCA Gallery in Eastchester, New York. Clients may, at their own cost, arrange for a proxy (e.g. furniture restorer, automotive mechanic, art authenticator, etc.) to examine items on their behalf.

Invoices are sent to the registered email address of the winning bidder (Buyer) at the conclusion of the auction. Invoices must be paid no later than five business days following the auction. Failure to submit on-time payment may result in the forfeiture of items. Payment may be made by cash, wire transfer, or credit card. Automobile invoices must be paid via wire transfer. The final invoice will be the total of the winning bid amount; the buyer's premium; applicable sales taxes; and any storage, handling, and contracted shipping costs.

CCA collects and remits applicable sales tax on all items collected at the Eastchester gallery or shipped within the state of New York as required by law. For purchases shipped to a domestic address outside of New York, Buyer will pay any sales tax CCA is required to collect for that state.
